name: Alcohol Cutoff
title: Stop alcohol at least three hours before bed.
benefit: Better sleep quality and sharper mornings.
subtitle: Alcohol Timing
rationale: Alcohol close to bedtime suppresses REM and fragments the second half of the night even at moderate doses.

evidence.summary: Experimental studies consistently show pre-sleep alcohol suppresses REM and fragments the second half of the night even at moderate doses.

indications: Drinks regularly land within two hours of bedtime.
Sleep tracking shows depressed HRV or fragmented sleep after drinking evenings.
Night waking clusters after social dinners.
